capabilities: Animate folding and unfolding so lines slide instead of jumping
Animate line moves, indents, Enter and Backspace edits
Glide the cursor to its new position
Slide content rendered below the editor, such as the backlinks section
Work with any command or plugin that edits or folds text
disambiguation: Not an outliner; it only animates line and cursor movement in the regular editor and changes no note content.
extras: Tested on desktop only; mobile is untested. Animation on opening or switching notes is off by default and must be enabled in settings. Updates and feedback go through the author's Twitter (@Matsurimywaifu).
motivation: The author was inspired by Bike Outliner, a Mac outliner whose smooth fold, move and indent animations make outlining feel alive, and wanted to bring that feel to Obsidian.
problem: In Obsidian, editor changes like folding, moving or deleting lines happen instantly with no transition, which makes outlining feel abrupt.

summary: Editor animation plugin that makes lines glide smoothly when folding, unfolding, moving, indenting, adding or deleting lines, with a sliding cursor.
